mapper.sql:
SELECT r.REVIEW_CODE, r.CLASS_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, ( SELECT MIN(ci.IMAGE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY ci.SORT_ORDER) FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND ci.TYPE = '대표' ) AS THUMBNAIL_PATH, m.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, r.STAR_RATING AS RATING, r.CONTENT AS REVIEW_CONTENT, r.INPUT_DATE AS REVIEW_DATE, CASE WHEN r.REPLY_CONTENT IS NULL THEN 'pending' ELSE 'replied' END AS REPLY_STATUS, r.REPLY_CONTENT, r.REPLY_DATE FROM REVIEW r JOIN CLASS c ON r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_CODE = m.MEMBER_CODE
ORDER BY r.INPUT_DATE ASC, r.REVIEW_CODE ASC
ORDER BY r.STAR_RATING DESC, r.INPUT_DATE DESC
ORDER BY r.STAR_RATING ASC, r.INPUT_DATE DESC
ORDER BY r.INPUT_DATE DESC, r.REVIEW_CODE DESC
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_REVIEW_COUNT, COUNT(r.REPLY_CONTENT) AS REPLIED_REVIEW_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN r.REPLY_CONTENT IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS UNANSWERED_REVIEW_COUNT FROM REVIEW r JOIN CLASS c ON r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode}

SELECT c.CLASS_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, COUNT(r.REVIEW_CODE) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM CLASS c LEFT JOIN REVIEW r ON r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} GROUP BY c.CLASS_CODE, c.NAME ORDER BY c.NAME
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW r JOIN CLASS c ON r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE

SELECT r.REVIEW_CODE, r.CLASS_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, m.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, m.IMAGE AS MEMBER_PROFILE_PATH, r.STAR_RATING AS RATING, r.CONTENT AS REVIEW_CONTENT, r.INPUT_DATE AS REVIEW_DATE, CASE WHEN r.REPLY_CONTENT IS NULL THEN 'pending' ELSE 'replied' END AS REPLY_STATUS, r.REPLY_CONTENT, r.REPLY_DATE FROM REVIEW r JOIN CLASS c ON r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_CODE = m.MEMBER_CODE WHERE r.REVIEW_CODE = #{reviewCode} AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode}

SELECT REVIEW_IMG_CODE AS REVIEW_IMAGE_CODE, REVIEW_CODE, REVJEW_IMG AS IMAGE_PATH, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY REVIEW_IMG_CODE) AS IMAGE_ORDER FROM REVIEW_IMG WHERE REVIEW_CODE = #{reviewCode} ORDER BY REVIEW_IMG_CODE
